title: 3 website mistakes that cost you customers

shots.line: Mhoro! Three website mistakes that quietly cost you customers.
One: your site doesn't work on a phone. Most people in Zimbabwe browse on mobile — if it's hard to read, they leave.
Two: no clear way to contact you. Put your phone number and a WhatsApp or enquiry button on every page.
Three: it's slow. If it takes more than a few seconds, people won't wait.
We fix all three. Book a free call and we'll tell you what's holding your site back.
